description: This file declares the JSONWebToken class, which provides functionality for encoding, decoding, and validating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) using a specified cryptographic mode (e.g., SHA256). It includes class constructors, destructors, and methods for handling JWT payloads and signatures.
external_methods: string& Encode(string& token, const uint16_t length, const uint8_t payload[]) const
uint16_t Decode(const string& token, const uint16_t maxLength, uint8_t payload[]) const
bool ValidSignature(const mode type, const string& token) const

classes.name: JSONWebToken
classes.description: A class providing methods for encoding, decoding, and validating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) with support for different cryptographic modes.
